create_hftransform_tokenizer: create an HFTransform module to tokenize text using a HuggingFace tokenizer with configurable max sequence length
run_hftransform_forward_single: run the HFTransform forward pass to tokenize a list of single text strings with padding and truncation
run_hftransform_forward_pair: run the HFTransform forward pass to tokenize text pairs using the HuggingFace tokenizer with special tokens
build_hftransform_custom_model: build an HFTransform module with a custom model path and custom max sequence length for tokenization
review_hftransform_config: review the HFTransform class to understand tokenizer configuration options like add_special_tokens and return_tensors
